investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Helix Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: AWS us-west-2 (zones us-west-2a/us-west-2b/us-west-2c/us-west-2d); network range 10.40.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster helix-prod-uswest (EKS); Database: postgres instance billing-db-01 for billing-api; Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
